display_name: Bảo Minh property all risks insurance rules (Quy tắc bảo hiểm mọi rủi ro cho tài sản): the insuring clause and proviso, exclusions 1-11, General Conditions 1-15 and the closing note

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of the raw text rendering, and in short runs (strings, comments, NOTES.md, GLOSSARY.md, COMPARABLES.md) that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in it. No line carries the [translator] marker: the encoder wrote no Vietnamese of its own.

source.rendering: ../../source/raw/baominh-par.txt (pdftotext -layout; sha256 449e9eb1bb708701651817fc722293165ae1fedcfc8695801c5fcfe7a0d52faf on the encoding machine); src:N is line N of it
source.authority: the insurer's own standard-form rules, published on its website; private contract terms, not law

aids.use: read only, to record where the Law on Insurance Business fills or conflicts with the document (forks tagged LAW in NOTES.md); not encoded

exports: `the answer for the claim` (baominh-par-claim.l4): what the Insurer must pay for one loss, or why nothing is payable
scope: The whole document, as published at its URL on 2026-10-06. Encoded: the insuring clause with its definition of Tổn hại (Damage) and its proviso; exclusions 1 to 11 (two numbered 10), every limb and write-back; General Conditions 2 to 15, two of them as regulative rules (GC 7, GC 9); the short-period scale generated from the text. Inert, with reasons in NOTES.md section 2: the title and footers, GC 1, exclusion 3's severance sentence, exclusion 5's last sentence, exclusion 11 Part 3, the procedural rest of GC 7, GC 11's no-election sentence, the closing note. Everything the document leaves to the Schedule is an input with no default. The Law on Insurance Business is recorded, not encoded.

forks.F1: Definition of Damage: 'có tính bất ngờ' (sudden and unforeseen) qualifies loss, damage and destruction.
forks.F2: Both the first and the last day of a period of insurance are inside it.
forks.F3: Causation: 'gây ra bởi' reaches a direct link only; 'phát sinh từ' and 'trực tiếp hoặc gián tiếp' reach any link (exclusions 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11).
forks.F4: Proviso (i): the total sum insured and each item's sum insured both cap the aggregate.
forks.F5: Exclusion 1(c) write-back: limbs (i) and (ii) are both required ('và').
forks.F6: Exclusion 1(a)(i): 'do quá trình sử dụng' qualifies wear and tear; it decides no answer here.
forks.F7: Exclusion 3 d) proviso reaches d)(ii) (unlawful occupation) only.
forks.F8: Exclusion 5, garbled: pollution Damage excluded except Damage caused by (a) pollution from an insured peril or (b) an insured peril from pollution.
forks.F9: Exclusion 6(a): property not confirmed as insured is excluded outright, even from the listed perils.
forks.F10: A 'cause not excluded' is judged against the exclusions that name causes, not those that name property.
forks.F11: Exclusion 11 Part 1 write-back: the list after 'như' is exhaustive and reaches direct causes.
forks.F12: Exclusion 11 Part 2 reaches only an amount claimed as a cost of altering a computer system, not the value of physical Damage to one.
forks.F13: Exclusion 9's marine excess is taken on the Damage, before average and contribution.
forks.F14: GC 13: the deductible is taken once per loss, after average, contribution and the proviso's caps.
forks.F15: GC 14: average on actual value at the time of the loss, as the document agrees (LAW art 48(2) allows agreement).
forks.F16: GC 6: the rateable proportion is by sums insured (LAW art 49(2)).
forks.F17: GC 9(a) 'ngay lập tức': a judgement on the facts in the claim decision; a parameter (0 days in the tests) in the regulative rule.
forks.F18: GC 2 applies as written: no intent or causal link required (LAW art 22(2) requires intent; recorded, not applied).
forks.F19: GC 3: 7 calendar days from sending; cover ends on the seventh day; refund pro rata by days left (LAW art 26 recorded).
forks.F20: GC 3 short-period scale: an edge date (exactly 3 or 6 months) falls in the first row, the lower charge.
forks.F21: GC 7: 'sau 2 tháng' and 'trong vòng 2 tháng' both inclusive from receipt; the appointment window is one day.
forks.F22: GC 8(a): a change of the Insured's business ends cover without any increase of risk.
forks.F23: GC 8(b): 30 or more consecutive calendar days unattended; cover does not revive.
forks.F24: GC 9(b): 30 days from becoming aware of the incident (LAW art 30's one year recorded, not applied).
forks.F25: GC 15: calendar days, start day excluded; the period's length counts both ends.
forks.F26: GC 15 1(c): read as a period of insurance under 30 days; premium due within the period.
forks.F27: GC 15: clause 2 governs clause 1; a loss up to the last day of the warranty period is covered though the premium is never paid (LAW art 27(1)(c)).
forks.F28: Conditions precedent: any breach defeats the whole claim (LAW arts 19(3), 46 recorded, not applied).
forks.F29: GC 4(b): three calendar months, month-end clamped.
forks.F30: Second exclusion 10(a)(ii): a fire or explosion in the same chain as a data matter is taken to have arisen from it.
forks.F31: GC 13: 'mỗi tổn thất' (each loss) is one loss record as the caller groups it.
forks.F32: GC 9(a)(iii): malicious acts of anyone call for police notice.
forks.F33: The valuation basis ('giá trị của tài sản', 'giá trị thực tế') is not decided: an input.
forks.F34: LAW: the document sets no payment deadline; art 31(1) gives 15 days (not encoded).
